sar.reason: Policy threshold triggered mandatory SAR filing.
sar.narrative: The SAR concerns case HHG-004 involving a customer whose identity status is verified. The trigger is transaction TXN-004 which received a risk score of 0.85. The transaction was processed under the account linked to case HHG-004. No specific flagged transaction details are available, but the system flagged the activity based on the high risk score. The analysis identified one device relationship connecting the current activity to prior activity. A prior closed case, HIST-991, was adjudicated as fraud and involved a card‑not‑present pattern. The relevance note indicates a shared device profile was detected between the current activity and HIST-991. The combination of a high risk score, a shared device with a known fraud case, and the absence of a flagged transaction makes the activity suspicious.

containment_steps: Place temporary security authorization hold on transaction TXN-004
Issue immediate network-level block on all linked card PANs
